notes: 🎯 WEEK 1 OF 4 AT SIX SHIPS/WEEK (user committed 2026-09-02). This is a VOLUME week, not a test week. Power arithmetic: at 6 ships a 6%-escalation world and a 2% world are indistinguishable (31% vs 11% chance of seeing anything), so nothing here is framed as an experiment. Four weeks at 6/wk moves P(>=1 escalation) from 63% to 77%; one week moves it from 22% to 31%. The month is the unit, not the week. ⚠️ Per-ship effort MUST fall vs the 4/wk cadence or the month will not finish — and finishing is the whole point.
why_this_shape: Escalation, not packaging, is what stopped. Measured 2026-09-02: at ~28 days old the MEDIAN ship fell only 45,252 -> 19,993 impressions May->Aug (2.3x), but the p90 fell 625,002 -> 27,096 (23x). YouTube still runs the initial test; it stopped promoting anything past it.
Escalation was never earned by CTR: 4 of the 6 May videos that passed 600K impressions had BELOW-median CTR (one at 2.95%). So per-ship polish does not buy it.

Doubling is not a cause. May doubles escalated 7/28 (25%) vs singles 1/18 (6%), but Fisher p=0.124, and in June doubles went 0/8 once the wave ended. Doubling buys more tickets while a draw is running; it does not start one.
Three videos are 83% of the current decline and none is rescuable — impressions are being withdrawn while CTR RISES on all three (survivor bias, not a packaging fault).
Ads are not the lever: mid-rolls are already dense (~every 3 min, automatic slots on). Delivery is 1.37 ads/view because of FILL RATE, which is advertiser demand, not a setting.
